changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Each API_LIMIT row keeps the calls reserved in its open window.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE CONFIG.API_LIMIT ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS CALL_COUNT INTEGER; ALTER TABLE CONFIG.API_LIMIT ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS WINDOW_FROM_TS TIMESTAMPTZ;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE CONFIG.API_LIMIT DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS CALL_COUNT; ALTER TABLE CONFIG.API_LIMIT DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS WINDOW_FROM_TS;
